ov: The Atlantic puffin is a small seabird of the auk family with a big red-and-black beak. It nests in burrows on North Atlantic coasts and islands and dives for fish, swimming underwater with its wings.

why.et: Coastal peoples once took young puffins from their nests to eat.

rg: North Atlantic coasts: Iceland, Norway, Britain, Ireland, the Faroes, Greenland and Canada, south to Maine and Brittany.
df: Small fish, zooplankton and crabs, caught by diving.
fx: Hunting trips can take it 100 km or more from the nest.
